successors.name: Portuguese Angola
successors.text: the upper Kwango River, 'the Baixa de Cassange region of modern Angola along the Kwango River'

ledger.x: 1620: an Imbangala band that had deserted the Portuguese founds Kasanje on the upper Kwango.
1683 September: Matamba acknowledges Kasanje's independence in the treaty of 7 September 1683.
1910: Kasanje is absorbed into Portuguese Angola.

wars.name: Kasanje wars with Matamba and neighbours
wars.outcome: The page says Kasanje 'remained in a constant state of conflict with its neighbours, especially the kingdom of Matamba'; Nzinga fought it in 1634-1635 and Francisco in 1681; Matamba recognized Kasanje's independence in 1683.

certainty.note: No boundary is given; a trade state of the Kwango valley.
